selection.rule: Known-bad is v1 must_reject plus the newest nine command-center merged PRs in fix_recurrence.py snapshot examples whose changed lines a later Broken-project fix re-touched; source lines were attributed with git blame on the fix parent. Known-good is v1 must_approve plus the newest nine command-center ticket PRs merged in the prior seven-day slice of the same 14-day history window, with closed tickets and no Broken-project line fix during a complete seven-day follow-up ending at the snapshot. All new packets are at the exact approved PR head. Retrospective merge state, verdicts, review comments, post-approval comments, overlap history, and parent rejected excerpts are omitted for blinded review.

must_reject.reason: Reference to the immutable v1 must-reject calibration packet.

must_approve.reason: Reference to the immutable v1 must-approve calibration packet.
